title: Suggest tags
askAgain_one: Also ask again about {{count}} asset Claude was already asked about
askAgain_other: Also ask again about {{count}} assets Claude was already asked about
nothingNew: Claude was already asked about all of these.
sent: A small preview of each image, model, video and font, each file's name and the name of its folder, and the first 2 KB of text files. Never whole files or full paths. Audio is tagged from its name.
modelHint: Change it in Settings › AI features.
estimateHint: Batch prices, half the usual rate, billed to your API account.
when: Results usually arrive within an hour, and you can close Mimikit meanwhile. Suggested tags show in the side panel for you to accept or reject.
noKey: Suggest tags uses your own Anthropic API key, which isn't set yet.
sentToast_one: Sent {{count}} asset to Claude. Its suggested tags usually arrive within an hour.
sentToast_other: Sent {{count}} assets to Claude. Their suggested tags usually arrive within an hour.
paletteAction_one: Suggest tags for the {{count}} asset shown…
paletteAction_other: Suggest tags for the {{count}} assets shown…
acceptMany_one: Add #{{tag}} to the {{count}} selected asset that has it
acceptMany_other: Add #{{tag}} to the {{count}} selected assets that have it

settings.tagModelHint: For Suggest tags, which always runs at low effort through the Batch API.
settings.removeAllHint: Takes off every tag you accepted from Claude's suggestions. Tags you added yourself stay.
settings.removeConfirm_one: Remove {{count}} tag that came from Claude's suggestions?
settings.removeConfirm_other: Remove {{count}} tags that came from Claude's suggestions?
settings.noAiTags: No tags came from Claude's suggestions.
